{{Hatnote|This page is printed Decipher cards plus original Virtual Sets 1–15 (2002–2008 PDF slips), including [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]]. It is not the post-2014 [[Virtual Set 15]].}}
'''Premiere - Original VS15''' is the constructed pool of printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] plus original [[Players Committee]] Virtual Sets 1–15. [[Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier|Virtual Set 15]] (Galactic Frontier) has official text as of 21 March 2008.<ref name="vc15">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards15.pdf VirtualCards15.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008193554/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards15.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="vs2002">[[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]</ref> The pool includes [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]] (between original Virtual Sets 11 and 12). [[Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith|Virtual Set 16]] has official text as of 15 August 2008, after this cutoff.<ref name="vs2002" /> The short name '''POVS15''' redirects here.
